name: Partisia
description: Partisia is a multi-party computation (MPC) pioneer spun out of Aarhus University's Cryptography & Cyber Security group. The company co-developed PICNIC and FAEST, signature schemes that competed in the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography standardization process, and operates a quantum-proof cryptography platform built on 20+ years of MPC innovation. Partisia is a partner in the DKK 25.9M Innovation Fund Denmark AccessQKD project and has expanded into satellite-based QRNG infrastructure through alliances with Squareroot8 and NuSpace.
